related_questions.question: When will the new COVID vaccine be available in 2025?

text_blocks.snippet: The updated COVID-19 vaccines for the 2025-2026 season in the United States are expected to be available in the fall of 2025, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov). The FDA's Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee (VRBPAC) has recommended a monovalent JN.1-lineage vaccine for this season. The CDC also recommends a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults 18 and older.

related_questions.question: What are the side effects of the newest COVID vaccine?

text_blocks.snippet: The most recent COVID-19 vaccines are designed to be safe and effective, with side effects generally being mild and temporary. Common side effects include pain, soreness, redness, or swelling at the injection site, as well as fatigue, headache, muscle aches, joint pain, chills, and fever. These side effects typically resolve within a few days.
snippet_highlighted_words: pain, soreness, redness, or swelling at the injection site, as well as fatigue, headache, muscle aches, joint pain, chills, and fever

list.title: Injection Site Reactions:
list.snippet: Pain, soreness, redness, and swelling at the injection site are frequently reported.

list.title: Flu-like Symptoms:
list.snippet: Fatigue, headache, muscle aches, joint pain, chills, and fever are also common.

list.title: Other:
list.snippet: Some individuals may experience nausea or vomiting, particularly after the Moderna vaccine.
Allergic Reactions: Serious allergic reactions are rare but can occur.

Myocarditis and Pericarditis: These inflammatory conditions of the heart have been reported, particularly in young males, after mRNA vaccines (Pfizer and Moderna), but the risk is generally low and these conditions usually resolve.
Over-the-counter pain relievers and fever reducers: Medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help relieve symptoms.
Rest and hydration: Getting plenty of rest and staying hydrated can aid in recovery.
Cold compress: Applying a cold compress to the injection site can help reduce pain and swelling.

list.title: Severe or persistent side effects:
list.snippet: If side effects are severe or persist for more than a few days, it's best to consult with a healthcare professional.

list.title: Signs of allergic reaction:
list.snippet: If you experience difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or throat, or other signs of a serious allergic reaction, seek immediate medical attention.
Individual variation: Side effects can vary from person to person.
Benefits outweigh risks: The benefits of COVID-19 vaccination in preventing severe illness, hospitalization, and death far outweigh the risks of side effects.
